title: Convert the bootstrap wizard with bits-ui

costar.context: The maintainer said convert the webui, and the primitive library is bits-ui. Bootstrap is the next unfinished portal screen.
costar.objective: Convert the bootstrap wizard from assets/webui, using bits-ui for choices and checkboxes, and show it only when x:Bootstrap/get returns a record.
costar.style: One slice of the portal conversion.
costar.response: The wizard uses the schema steps and bits-ui. This server stays on the portal because it is not in bootstrap mode. Finish is not sent here.

concerns: This running server is not in bootstrap mode. x:Bootstrap/get returns notFound. The portal must stay visible and Finish must not be sent.
Object fields are variant records. This slice chooses the variant name. Nested store fields stay for a later pass of the same form.
bits-ui is the primitive. The catalog still owns the tokens and does not fetch.
context: The bundle replaces the admin with BootstrapWizard when the signed-in session has no layout it can open. The engine only returns the bootstrap singleton from x:Bootstrap/get while bootstrap mode is on. The form has five sections. serverSet fields are omitted. Finish posts x:Bootstrap/set with update.singleton.
current_state: The wizard renders the five schema steps with bits-ui. The portal shows it only when x:Bootstrap/get returns a record. Finish does not post from the portal or from /setup.
target_design: emit-portal writes the five steps. The wizard renders them with bits-ui checkbox and select. The portal layout fetches x:Bootstrap/get and shows the wizard only when a record is returned.
changes: Render the wizard and keep Finish off this server.
boundaries: Do not call x:Bootstrap/set against this running server.
Do not add a document editor.

verification.name: wizard-follows-the-schema
verification.proves: Five steps, the portal sentences, serverSet fields omitted, an empty get stays on the portal, and the wizard imports bits-ui without fetching.

verification.name: ui-types
verification.proves: The wizard, bits-ui, and the portal layout typecheck.
